subject: .github/workflows/ci.yml
source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
text = Path(".github/workflows/ci.yml").read_text()
start = text.index("  lowest-direct:")
job = text[start:]
assert "--resolution lowest-direct" in job
assert "runs-on: ubuntu-latest" in job
assert "python-version: \"3.11\"" in job
assert "uv run pytest -q" in job
assert "astral-sh/setup-uv@c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7 # v10.2.0" in job
assert "permissions:\n  contents: read\n" in text
print("lowest-direct ci job ok")'
